title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Debuts New Opening Ahead of Steel Ball Run Return – Watch Now
content: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure is set to kick off the new slate of Fall 2026 anime releases with the return of Steel Ball Run , and the anime has dropped its new opening theme sequence early ahead of its big comeback.
author: ComicBook

title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 3 Announced
content: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 3 anime was officially announced immediately after the second season ended. The second season of the anime was announced immediately after the first one, and it premiered on July 8.
author: Anime Corner

title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Opening Video Released, Theme Song by Kroi
content: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure revealed the opening video and song ahead of the 2ND and 3RD STAGE premiere on September 25 . The anime previously confirmed 11 episodes for stages 2 and 3, along with weekly streaming on Netflix.
author: Anime Corner

title: Bleach’s Final Season to Officially Reveal Ichigo’s Son Ahead of Anime Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is now in the works on its final two episodes ever, and the anime is going to reveal the voice behind Ichigo Kurosaki’s son ahead of the anime’s grand finale.
author: ComicBook

title: Light Novel 'Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level Max ni Nattemashita' Concludes with 30th Volume
content: The official X account for Kisetsu Morita and Benio 's Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level Max ni Nattemashita ( I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level ) light novel announced on Wednesday that the series will end with its 30th volume, scheduled to be released on October 15.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Odekake Hololive' Announces Cast Members, Main Staff

title: hololive Anime Reveals Official Title, Teaser Visual and 29 Participating Talents
content: hololive’s first TV anime titled Odekake hololive ( Odeholo ) revealed a new teaser visual featuring all 29 participating talents. The official English title is hololive: Let’s Head Out! The anime is being created as part of Hololive’s 10th anniversary project.
author: Anime Corner

title: Rock Band Kroi Performs STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Anime's Opening Song
content: Warner Bros. Japan announced on Wednesday that rock band Kroi is performing the opening theme song "Spin" for the STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure anime, and began streaming the anime's clean opening sequence: Warner Bros.
author: ANN

title: 6th Live-Action Midnight Diner Series Reveals Returning Cast, Staff, October 20 Debut
content: The staff for the sixth live-action series adaptation of Yarō Abe 's Shinya Shokudō (The Midnight Diner or La Cantine de Minuit ) manga announced on Wednesday the new series' returning cast members, returning and new directors, writers, and October 20 premiere on MBS , TBS and other channels in Japan.
author: ANN
